answer_line: The model generates 12×12 grayscale images showing a single **hollow, axis-aligned square** (1-pixel-wide white `#` outline on a black `.` background), with a black interior and a black 1-pixel outer border on all four sides of the 12×12 image. The squares vary in size (side lengths from about 4×4 to 9×9 pixels, most commonly 5×5 to 8×8) and position within the central 10×10 region (rows 1..10, columns 1..10).
